title: Hole Edit Selection Rotation
notes: Adds Rotate Left 90°, Rotate 180°, and Rotate Right 90° to Hole Edit.
Makes selection rotation available in both Drill Logs and Shot Diagrams, including independently created Shot Diagrams.
Rotates the selected hole layout around its top-left bounding-box anchor and keeps the rotated holes selected.
Warns before rotation replaces occupied destination holes and supports Undo.
Preserves the m40.1.3 desktop purple selection highlight fix.
Preserves all m40.1 cloud safety and all m40.0.4 timing, backup, conversion, PDF, pattern, page, and document behavior.
